name: GLI family zinc finger 1

function.text: GLI1 encodes transcription activator GLI1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Gastroblastoma; GLI1-altered mesenchymal tumor, malignant/metastasizing. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: GLI1 encodes transcription activator GLI1. It is a transcription activator that acts as a key effector of the smoothened signaling pathway, and which plays a role in craniofacial development and digital development, as well as development of the central nervous system and gastrointestinal tract. It binds to the DNA consensus sequence 5'-GACCACCCA-3'.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving GLI1 have been reported in gastroblastoma and GLI1-altered mesenchymal tumor, malignant/metastasizing.
